Dear Metro Retail Group,

Thank you for bringing this to our attention. We have logged your report that shipment SHP-1002 was not received, despite a delivery status appearing in the tracking system.

We want to assure you that this matter is being treated with the highest priority. We have immediately launched a formal investigation with our carrier partner to verify the delivery details and obtain full documentation.

Here is what you can expect from us:
• A dedicated team member has been assigned to your case
• We will provide you with an update within 24 business hours
• If our investigation confirms non-delivery, we will work with you directly on a resolution — whether that involves re-shipment, credit, or another option that meets your needs

We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience and understand how frustrating this situation must be, especially given your recent experiences. Your business is extremely important to us, and we are committed to resolving this swiftly and to your satisfaction.

If you have any additional details that may assist our investigation (e.g., dock receipts, facility camera footage, delivery schedules), please don't hesitate to share them.

Thank you for your patience and trust.

Sincerely,
Logistics Operations Team

Dear Metro Retail Group Team,

Thank you for notifying us regarding shipment SHP-1002. We understand you have reported that this shipment has not been received, despite the carrier's delivery scan, and we take this matter very seriously.

We want to assure you that we have taken immediate action:

• We have opened a formal investigation with our carrier, WestLine Logistics, requesting full documentation to verify the delivery status.
• This case has been escalated internally to ensure it receives priority attention.
• A dedicated team member will be managing this case through to resolution.

We are committed to providing you with a substantive update within the next 24 hours as the carrier investigation progresses.

In the meantime, if you have any supporting information that may assist our investigation — such as dock receiving logs, facility access records, or security camera footage from the expected delivery time — please share it with us at your convenience. This can help expedite resolution.

We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience and appreciate your patience as we work to resolve this promptly.

Best regards,
Logistics Operations Team

Logistics Operations Team

Dear Metro Retail Group,

Thank you for bringing this to our attention. We understand you are reporting non-receipt of your shipment SHP-1002 (consumer electronics), despite the carrier, WestLine Logistics, marking it as delivered.

We want to assure you that we take this matter very seriously. After reviewing the carrier's records, we have confirmed that no valid Proof of Delivery (POD) exists for this shipment — no signature, delivery photo, or GPS confirmation has been provided by the carrier.

We have opened a formal investigation with WestLine Logistics and have demanded full delivery documentation within 24 hours. Our team is actively working to determine the status and location of your shipment.

Your account representative, Jordan Patel, will follow up with you within 1–2 business days with an update on our investigation findings and next steps.

In the meantime, if you have any supporting information that may assist in the investigation — such as receiving dock logs, security camera footage, or delivery area observations — please do not hesitate to share it with us.

We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience and appreciate your patience as we work to resolve this promptly.

Best regards,
Logistics Operations Team
